cohort: Pregnant women with moyamoya disease at Tokyo Medical and Dental University Hospital from 1991 to 2019
finding: Pregnant women with moyamoya disease have a high rate of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and cesarean sections, while experiencing a low prevalence of ischemic stroke and no hemorrhagic strokes in the peripartum period.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 96.2% of deliveries among women with moyamoya disease, and 60% of those with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy required emergency cesarean section.
